one_line: Kadamba emperor at the dynasty’s zenith, a Jain-patron Brahmanical king famed for his diplomatic alliances with Gupta and Vakataka worlds.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium-tall, athletic but not bulky, with the poised bearing of a seasoned yet graceful ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful look; medium-brown Deccan complexion; straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; a small tilaka on the forehead; default expression is composed, dignified and slightly warm, as if weighing alliances.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, neatly tied topknot (kundala-style) at the back of the crown, sides smoothly combed; a narrow gold headband with a central green stone sits low across the forehead, holding the topknot, with a thin cloth tie at the back.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early 5th-century Deccan royal attire: an off-white, knee-length cotton angarkha-style upper garment with wrap front and fitted half-sleeves, lightly patterned with faint cream stripes; over this, a rich deep-maroon silk uttariya draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the back, edges woven with a narrow gold border; a finely pleated golden-ochre silk dhoti wrapped securely from waist to just above the ankles in the classic Deccan style with a forward pleat, tied by a broad red-and-gold woven waist-belt; simple brown leather sandals; jewellery includes a pair of medium gold ear-rings (simple circular kundalas), a single solid gold torque-like neck collar, two gold armlets with leaf motifs on the upper arms, and three slim gold bangles on each wrist; a narrow cloth girdle peeks beneath the belt, and a small beaded Jain pendant hangs discreetly from the neck collar, hinting at his Jain patronage within a Brahmanical royal frame.
appearance.signature: A finely crafted straight double-edged iron sword of early classical Indian type with a modest crossguard, slightly flared pommel and plain scabbard; the scabbard is deep brown leather with a subtle gold-tip fitting, worn slung from his left side by a red-and-gold woven baldric that crosses his chest under the uttariya, and he often rests his right hand lightly on the hilt as a composed warrior-king.

ref_desc: Kakusthavarma of Banavasi is a medium-tall, early-40s Deccan king with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, short beard, black hair in a high topknot held by a gold headband, wearing an off-white angarkha, golden-ochre dhoti, deep-maroon uttariya, gold jewellery and Jain pendant, brown sandals, and carrying a straight double-edged sword in a deep-brown scabbard with red-and-gold baldric as his signature weapon, in a palette of deep maroon, golden ochre, off-white, warm brown and gold.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Kakusthavarma of Banavasi: a dignified, medium-tall Deccan king in his early 40s with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, sharp jawline, short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, and a calm, composed default expression. His thick black hair is gathered into a high, neat topknot at the back of the crown, sides smooth, secured by a narrow gold headband with a central green stone and a tied cloth at the back. He wears an off-white, knee-length cotton angarkha-style upper garment with wrap front and fitted half-sleeves, faint cream striping, over which a rich deep-maroon silk uttariya is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, edged with a narrow gold border. His lower body is clothed in a finely pleated golden-ochre silk dhoti wrapped in early 5th-century Deccan style from waist to just above the ankles with a forward pleat, held by a broad red-and-gold woven waist-belt, with a narrow cloth girdle visible beneath. On his feet are simple brown leather sandals. Show jewellery: medium gold circular kundala earrings, a solid gold torque-like neck collar from which hangs a small discreet Jain-themed pendant, two gold armlets with leaf motifs on the upper arms, and three slim gold bangles on each wrist. His signature weapon is a straight double-edged iron sword with modest crossguard and slightly flared pommel; the deep-brown leather scabbard with a subtle gold tip hangs at his left side from a red-and-gold woven baldric that crosses his chest beneath the uttariya, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, golden ochre, off-white, warm brown and gold, and present him in neutral, front, side and back poses to clearly show face, hair, garments, jewellery, sandals and sword placement in a heroic yet historically grounded style.
